beats.summary: Michael proposes using graphics like storm clouds and fireworks to make quarterly reports more engaging.

evidence.snippet: Michael: And the same thing goes for quarterly reports. They are unreadable. They're just numbers and boring and blech.

beats.summary: Dwight challenges the new company website to compete with him in making sales, while Angela doubts the website's success.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: That's ridiculous. I'm not going to be beaten by a website.
Angela: Waste of time. The website's going to win.

beats.summary: Dwight's mercy killing of Angela's cat causes tension between them.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Dwight mercy killed Angela's cat. It's very complicated.

beats.summary: Michael announces the launch of the Dunder-Mifflin Infinity website and the related satellite parties connected to a New York City event.

evidence.snippet: Michael: And… today the Dunder-Mifflin Infinity website officially launches.

beats.summary: Phyllis attempts to manage Angela's difficult behavior while preparing for the launch party.

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: Angela is worse than usual lately, and we have a party to throw.

beats.summary: Angela is upset about a banner typo changing 'launch party' to 'lunch party' and expresses anger towards Phyllis.

evidence.snippet: Angela: I feel angry. Angry at you. Angry at you for doing something stupid.
Angela: It's supposed to say launch!

notable_quotes.quote: I saw it, and it was amazing!
notable_quotes.speaker: Pam

evidence.snippet: Pam: I saw it. I saw it, and it was amazing! Who said I didn't see it?

notable_quotes.quote: The website is the brain-child of my brain-child, Ryan. It is my brain-grandchild.
notable_quotes.speaker: Michael

evidence.snippet: Michael: Well the website is the brain-child of my brain-child, Ryan. It is my brain-grandchild.

notable_quotes.quote: I can make more sales than a computer. In fact, I challenge that website to make more sales than me today.
notable_quotes.speaker: Dwight

evidence.snippet: I can make more sales than a computer. In fact, I challenge that website to make more sales than me today.
